subject: Reranker integration  post-call recap & eval plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@acme-retail.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com, connor_obrien@redwood.inference.com
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Reranker integration  post-call recap & eval plan

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier  great conversation and really appreciate the context on your search and recommendations pipeline. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get a focused evaluation running: 

What we heard from you:
- Use case: product search + personalized recommendations; reranker will run as a second-stage re-ranker after an ANN candidate set (top 100).
- Key constraints: 100ms P90 for the reranker step, support for up to 60 qps burst, and tenant isolation for user embeddings.
- Success metrics: NDCG@10 improvement over current baseline, precision@K for top-5 and top-10, and latency under the SLO.

Proposed Redwood plan / ask of Acme:
1) Integration touchpoints: SDK setup + auth (API key + optional scoped token), routing (route rerank requests to Dedicated pool), and structured output/tool calling for downstream signals. See attached Reranker_Integration_Specs.md for details.
2) Eval artifacts we need from you: sample ANN candidate payloads (JSON lines), a labeled relevance set or click logs mapped to relevance judgments, and a small prompt/eval set for edge cases. We attached a starter eval_prompt_set.csv.
3) Top_k tuning: suggest we test top_k values [10, 20, 50, 100] and measure NDCG@10, precision@5/10. We can also run a continuous A/B with automatic rollback if quality drops.
4) Timeline: if you can share data and test keys by next Tue (2027-03-30), we can deliver an initial eval report within 7 business days.

Next steps / asks: can you share the sample ANN payload and a short list of 3 priority queries to start with? Also confirm whether you prefer API key auth or scoped service tokens for the eval environment.

Attachments: Reranker_Integration_Specs.md (text/markdown), eval_prompt_set.csv (text/csv)

Thanks  looping in Steph and Connor for technical follow-up.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0119
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@acme-retail.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reranker integration  post-call recap & eval plan

Thanks Marissa  this is great and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifying questions from our side before we hand over data: 

1) SDK & auth: we prefer scoped service tokens tied to the test environment rather than a global API key. Can you confirm Redwood supports short-lived scoped tokens and an easy token rotation flow?

2) Ranking API: does Redwood provide a dedicated ranking API that accepts (query, candidate_list) and returns scores, or do we need to adapt to a generation-style endpoint? Also: can the API return both scores and structured metadata (e.g., reason codes for why an item ranked up/down)?

3) top_k: we currently pass top 100 from ANN. In the eval I want to understand tradeoffs with top_k=10,20,50,100. Will you run batch experiments for us and provide delta tables for NDCG/latency?

4) Metrics: besides NDCG and precision, can you support MRR and a custom business-weighted relevance metric? We'll try to provide a mapping of click signals to relevance labels.

We can share a redacted payload by EOD Friday (2027-03-26). Regarding SLA, we may need an enterprise SLA for production  happy to review your draft.

Thanks,
Alex
Senior Product Manager  Search
Acme Retail
alex.torres@acme-retail.com
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Alex Torres <alex.torres@acme-retail.com>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.inference.com
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reranker integration  post-call recap & eval plan

Hey all  Steph from Solutions here. A few technical notes / proposals based on Alex's questions: 

- Auth: Redwood supports short-lived scoped tokens (JWT-based) that can be minted via the control plane with fine-grained scopes (model:rerank:eval, project:acme-test). We also support standard API keys for quick POC but recommend scoped tokens for eval/prod.

- Ranking API: We expose a Rerank endpoint (POST /v1/rerank) that accepts a JSON payload: {
  "query": "...",
  "candidates": [{"id":"sku1","embedding_vec":[...],"metadata":{...}}, ...],
  "top_k": 50,
  "return_reason": true
}
Response returns ordered ids + scores + optional structured reasons (if return_reason=true). For the SDK, we have a Node + Python client with a rerank helper that handles batching and streaming scores.

- top_k experiments: we can run offline experiments (compute scores for each candidate set then simulate top_k cutoffs) and also run an online canary with traffic split. We'll provide delta tables (CSV) that include NDCG@10/20, precision@5/10, MRR, and latency distributions.

- Embeddings & tenant isolation: we recommend storing tenant embeddings in a customer-managed bucket or using our Dedicated pools with per-tenant namespaces; Connor can follow up on exact KV/cache isolation.

Connor: can you confirm the expected endpoint latency for our Dedicated SLO at 60 qps? Rough ballpark numbers are helpful for Acme to set expectations.

Thanks  I'll attach a short spec and example payload.

 Steph
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com
From: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@acme-retail.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reranker integration  post-call recap & eval plan

Hi Alex / Priya  Connor here, infra lead on the account. Quick answers: 

- Dedicated SLO: for a 60 qps burst with our optimized reranker model (quantized 4-bit profile) we expect P50   2030ms and P95   80120ms depending on candidate set size and sequence length. With top_k=100 you'll be closer to the upper bound. We can tune batching and KV prefix caching to push P95 under 100ms for most workloads.

- Routing: we can route rerank calls to your Dedicated pool by project tag; fallback policy can route to a compatible hosted variant if Dedicated capacity is saturated.

- Structured reasons: we support a structured reason object with a short explanation string and a reason_code enum; the feature is opt-in in the request (return_reason=true) because it adds ~28ms depending on payload size.

Plan: once we get the redacted payload on Fri, we'll kick off the offline experiments (top_k sweep) and share the delta tables. If results look good, propose a 2-week canary with 10% traffic on production with metrics hooks.

I'll create a draft runbook and share the Drive link (shared in the related_links) by EOD.

 Connor
Infra Lead | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.inference.com
